title: Signal Batch Scout: aggregated enterprise feature intake and rapid first-pass scoping
creator: Leah Moreno
description: Run a scoped pilot process (Signal Batch Scout) to aggregate non-bug enterprise asks from Sales/CS, produce a compact prioritized summary, and return a fast first-pass feasibility and econ estimate to stakeholders. Deliverable: a single 1-page prioritized signal pack + recommended next-phase path (experiment, quick-win, or invest).
background: Sales and Customer Success are submitting a high volume of enterprise feature asks that overlap but are being reviewed individually. That leads to duplicate scoping work and slow feedback loops. We want a repeatable lightweight aggregation to reduce turnaround time and surface consolidated solutions that map to Redwood product levers (routing, dedicated, private, KV caching, console controls).
aggregated_signals: Acme Health: request for VPC-friendly model pinning + audit trail for HIPAA deployments (3 accounts across Q1)
FinArc: deterministic latency SLA (p95 < 120ms) for small-utterance reranking pipeline; willing to commit to Dedicated reserve
EduLyft: structured tool-calling with enforced schema validation and per-route cost cap for statewide pilot
RetailCo: need for multi-model routing policy (fallback to quantized cheaper variant during bursts) and token-level cost reporting integrated into their billing
scoring_rubric: Technical lift: 1-5 (engineering effort estimate and infra dependencies)
scoring_results: Acme Health -> pain:5 tech:3 revenue:4 security:high strategic:5 => Priority: P0 candidate
FinArc -> pain:4 tech:4 revenue:4 security:medium strategic:4 => Priority: P0/P1
EduLyft -> pain:3 tech:2 revenue:2 security:low strategic:3 => Priority: P2 (candidate for implementation pattern)
RetailCo -> pain:4 tech:3 revenue:3 security:low strategic:4 => Priority: P1
initial_scope_recommendation: Produce a 1-page Signal Pack and two implementation archetypes: (A) Compliance pack for Private/VPC onboarding (Acme Health) — immediate RFC + security checklist; (B) Performance routing + econ knobs pilot for FinArc and RetailCo — prototype on Dedicated with cost telemetry. EduLyft to be routed to structured-output SDK improvements backlog for a low-cost iteration.
tradeoffs_considered: Fast consolidation vs. precision: grouping similar asks may obscure account-specific constraints (e.g., KMS vs HSM choices)
Build small generic hooks vs. bespoke integrations: generic routing policy covers many customers but may delay high-value customizations
SLA commitments: offering deterministic p95 guarantees may require reserved capacity commitments that change our pricing/commit model
decisions: Adopt Signal Batch Scout cadence: weekly batch with 48-hour PM turnaround for initial pack
Use econ-tagging to capture willingness-to-pay on intake forms (Sales capture field)
Route security-heavy asks to Private onboarding stream with prioritized SOC/KMS checklist and a dedicated Solutions SE touch

We should include a small canonical prompt set for perf regressions tied to each Signal Pack to enable future quality monitoring
